brief:
Israeli occupation forces continued a bulldozing operation Sunday along the Jenin-Nablus Road near the village of Wadi ad-Daouq, south of Jenin in the northern West Bank, IMEMC News reported. The machinery destroyed Palestinian farmland and uprooted olive trees on both sides of the thoroughfare, affecting agricultural plots in the area.

Abdul Nasser Al-Hwaiti, head of the local authority, was present to document the destruction of crops and trees during the operation. The incident marked a continuation of such demolition activities in the region.

title: Israeli forces bulldoze Palestinian farmland near Jenin
